customManagers.description: Bump the DEFAULTS block of the dependency ledger (deps.json). The recursive first matchString scopes extraction to defaults only — the overrides block (per-version / per-platform holds) is deliberately outside the region, so Renovate never touches a pinned hold. Only tag-pinned entries with a datasource are matched; commit pins (x264, amf) and tarball deps (gmp, libmp3lame) are hand-managed.

packageRules.description: Group all ledger dependency bumps under a clear prefix so CI (build + docs-matrix) validates each PR against every FFmpeg line before merge.
